what: Independent re-check of the NEXUS X3D Hub Observatory release before publishing it as Demo 56

checks.name: X3D 4.0 XSD
checks.result: 19 of 20 valid; assets/hanim/scene.x3d invalid: HAnimHumanoid name='Articulation study' is not an xs:NMTOKEN (line 616)

checks.name: X3D semantic
checks.result: 3 files with 1 error each (naming-convention: whitespace in name on HAnimHumanoid and on MetadataSet 'IFC identity' in bim scene+roundtrip); 2 files with 1 warning (empty-group OB__materials in usd); the rest info only

checks.name: release's own claim
checks.tool: Web3D x3d.py 4.0.65.8 via repository adapter (from the release)
checks.result: 20 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings: this adapter does not check NMTOKEN, so it missed the HAnim name

checks.name: browser load
checks.tool: Playwright, headless Chromium 157.0.8103.78, SwiftShader (no GPU), X_ITE 16.7.1 as vendored, 1440x900
checks.result: 8 of 8 chapters loaded, 0 console errors, first ready 7.9 s, chapter loads 4.2 to 36.7 s (software rendering, not an FPS claim)

checks.name: chapters 04 and 05 look tilted
checks.tool: same rig, X_ITE StraightenHorizon on vs off
checks.result: the authored source.x3d Viewpoints carry a roll; X_ITE's default StraightenHorizon hides it in the source, but after Blender the camera sits under a rotated Transform and the roll shows. Geometry and Transforms are preserved (Blender bounds are upright). Fixture camera issue, not an add-on geometry bug

checks.name: leak sweep
checks.tool: grep over text files; zstandard-decompressed .blend strings
checks.result: no keys, emails or claude.ai links; .blend files hold the generic temp dir /home/agent; reel receipt holds the builder path /workspace/scratch/...

checks.name: add-on suite with the HAnim fix
checks.tool: bpy 5.3.0 (pip wheel), python -m unittest discover in tests/
checks.result: 910 tests OK, 48 skipped; the new test fails without the fix

not_tested: Unreal and Bonsai editors (the release says prepared, not executed)
Khronos glTF validator and OpenUSD reopen were not re-run here; those numbers are the release's own
motion-matrix and HAnim millimetre numbers are the release's own, not re-measured
